Maya Chen: flagged by support — a customer in eu-west reported sustained p95/p99 latency spikes for text-generation endpoints starting ~09:10 UTC. they attached traces and said it started after the midnight rollout.

Priya Nair: copying the excerpt from support ticket: 'p95 jumped from ~140ms to ~620ms, p99 from ~320ms to ~1.2s. errors are rare but timeouts up slightly. noticed more 429s when we push bursts.'

Jason Park: thanks. first quick check: any infra changes in eu-west cluster around midnight? autoscale events?

sre-bot: autoscaler: scale-up triggered for cluster-eu-west-1 at 2026-03-15T00:01:12Z (reason: CPU spike). No node drains recorded in last 6h.

Tim G: I'm seeing elevated tail latencies across all models for dedicated and hosted in eu-west. Prometheus shows a sharp drop in redwood_cache_kv_hits ratio starting at 00:00. Looks like cache hit-rate collapsed.

Jason Park: paste of relevant metrics (5m windows) — p95 and cache hit rate:
```
# prometheus (examples)
redwood_request_duration_seconds{quantile=\"0.95\",region=\"eu-west-1\"} 0.62
redwood_request_duration_seconds{quantile=\"0.99\",region=\"eu-west-1\"} 1.25
sum(rate(redwood_cache_kv_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_cache_kv_requests_total[5m])) 0.12
sum(rate(redwood_cache_kv_hits_total[5m])) 120
sum(rate(redwood_cache_kv_requests_total[5m])) 1000
```

Priya Nair: customer says they use prefixing to isolate tenants (prefix=teamXYZ_). could this be a prefix-key normalization bug?

Maya Chen: exactly what I suspected. recent PR that touched prefix normalization landed in midnight deploy (commit: 9f3a2c). Jason — can you pull logs from runtime process for cache key generation?

Jason Park: grabbing logs now. here's a snippet near 00:00:
```
[00:00:01] INFO kv_cache: insert key=\"teamXYZ_/v1/generate/conv#123\" size=512
[00:00:02] INFO kv_cache: insert key=\"teamXYZ_/v1/generate/conv#124\" size=512
[00:00:03] WARN kv_cache: evicting key=\"/v1/generate/conv#124\" reason=policy:LRU
[00:00:03] INFO kv_cache: insert key=\"teamXYZ_/v1/generate/conv#125\" size=512
```
Observation: some inserts are missing the prefix (evicted key without team prefix) — looks like inconsistent normalization between insert and eviction/key lookup.

Tim G: that would cause horrible thrash: inserts create prefixed keys but evictions/reads compare non-prefixed keys or vice versa, so effective cardinality explodes → tiny hit rate. Also I see high OOM-kicks on small LRU buckets.

Priya Nair: can we repro locally quickly? Steps?

Jason Park: repro steps I used in staging:
1) curl to batch endpoints with two tenants alternating prefixes (teamA_, teamB_) at ~200rps each.
2) watch internal /debug/cache snapshot endpoint.
3) check counts for normalized_key vs raw_key.

Commands:
```
# trigger load
hey -z 30s -q 200 -c 50 \"POST http://staging-runtime/generate\" -m POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST\"
# snapshot
curl http://staging-runtime/debug/cache | jq .buckets | head
```

Result: cache entries show both prefixed and unprefixed variants of same logical key. hit_rate falls to ~10%.

Maya Chen: OK mitigation path: we need an immediate hotfix to ensure normalization is consistent, and a short-term mitigation while we deploy: increase cache size for eu-west runtime and enable prefix warming for known tenant prefixes to avoid mass misses. Also rate-limit bursters per-tenant to avoid eviction storms.

Tim G: agree. i'll push a config change to raise kv_pool_capacity from 64MB to 192MB for the eu-west runtime fleet (non-disruptive config reload). also enable cache_prefetch=true for the top 50 tenants. that should raise hit rate while we fix code.

Jason Park: i have a microfix: rollback commit 9f3a2c or revert the normalization change. but safer to add a normalization shim at lookup path that canonicalizes keys both on insert and lookup until we deploy proper test-suite. I'll open a PR with tests.

Priya Nair: what's our deploy plan? customer needs ETA.

Jason Park: plan: 1) config bump (Tim) — 10 min; 2) apply lookup normalization shim (no-proto change, toggled by env) — 30 min canary in staging then 15 min rollout to eu-west if canary green; 3) full revert or proper fix in next release with test coverage.

deploy-bot: triggered rollout: config-change eu-west kv_pool_capacity -> 192MB by Tim G. status: started.

Maya Chen: also capture memory/eviction logs and a diff of keys before/after to share with product for root-cause and customer communication. Priya please coordinate comms: say we're investigating cache key normalization bug, apply mitigations, and ETA ~45-60min for customer-facing fix.

Priya Nair: will draft. sending interim note: 'we're applying mitigations to reduce latency and will follow up with RCA and next-steps.'

Jason Park: quick snippet for the shim (pseudocode) - to be added behind a runtime flag: 
```
func normalizeKey(k string) string {
  k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
  if !strings.HasPrefix(k, tenantPrefix) {
    return tenantPrefix + k
  }
  return k
}
// call both on insert and lookup
```
I'll attach unit tests that exercise inserts/evicts with and without prefix.

Tim G: canary metrics after config bump (5m window): hit_rate went 12% -> 35%, p95 620ms -> 280ms. still above baseline but much better.

sre-bot: rollout eu-west config-change by Tim G completed successfully at 2026-03-15T00:25:00Z.

deploy-bot: canary deploy: normalization-shim flag=true in staging by Jason Park. status: canary pass.

Jason Park: rolling normalization-shim to eu-west now. toggled flag=true on 3/3 runtime nodes; monitoring.

Tim G: after shim, hit_rate 35% -> 78%, p95 280ms -> 150ms, p99 1.25s -> 360ms. looks like we re-unified keys.

Maya Chen: nice. next actions: 1) ship proper patch that fixes normalization at source and add regression tests around prefix keys; 2) add e2e test that alternates tenants to catch thrash; 3) add metric alert: redwood_cache_kv_hit_rate < 50% for 3m in prod triggers paging. 4) postmortem with timeline and customer comms.

Priya Nair: customer notified with interim update, ETA for full fix: 4 hours (code + canary + prod). they acknowledged.

Jason Park: PR opened #4321 — includes shim + tests + issue link. tagging for review @Tim G, @Maya Chen.

Maya Chen: closing thread — leave a note when RC/patch rolled to stable. thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-0315-02, severity: high, root cause: cache key normalization bug; mitigations: config bump, normalization shim, rollout; next: permanent fix & tests.
